doc: The fixed shape of a triaged intake item (report 5.3 rule 2, DEC-15). ONE file, read by every consumer: the CI validator (.claude/scripts/intake_validate.py),
the loop's stage 2 (loopctl/intake.py), the intake-triage agent's prompt and the intake workflow template. A test fails if any of them drifts from it.
Stage 1 (a tool-less model) answers with this shape; the answer is derived from text a stranger wrote, so it is untrusted until stage 2 (a deterministic
script, no model) has checked it against this file. Nothing is ever added to a plan from it without a human (H1, H7).
